summary.text: Stephen Szczurko-Walton is the Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 31-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Drew Stokesbary.
A U.S. Navy veteran who worked as a nuclear reactor operator and has worked as an HVAC technician in Washington, he advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 42.0% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Szczurko-Walton graduated from Summit Preparatory Charter High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Santa Barbara in 2014, and earned a graduate degree from the State University of New York, Empire State College in 2025.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 2015 to 2024.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in the Bay Area, served nine and a half years as a nuclear reactor operator, deployed three times aboard the USS Theodore Roosevelt, and earned a Master of Public Administration before moving to Auburn, Washington, to raise his family.
His stated campaign priorities include bringing down the cost of healthcare, housing and energy for working families.

He also said he would work to pass a bill like SB 6358 to bar corporations, unions and non-profits from spending money to influence elections, and to modernize the electric grid and increase staffing and funding for the Utilities and Transportation Commission.
